content: Smoothed 1-4 character n-gram statistics only; no sentence text is packaged.

sources.name: Mozilla Common Voice sentence text (zh-CN, zh-TW)
KdConv dialogue utterances (film, music, travel chit-chat)
CrossWOZ dialogue utterances (hotel, restaurant, attraction, metro, taxi requests)
FineWeb-2 Mandarin web text (cmn_Hani, held-out shard)

sources.name: FineWeb-2 Mandarin web text (cmn_Hani, every 8th row group of the first training shard; word model only)

sources.name: Bundled dictionary words (internal n-grams only, no clause boundaries)

processing: Traditional text converted to simplified Chinese with OpenCC t2s (tw2sp for zh-TW).
Wikinews markup removed; interwiki link labels kept.
Text split into clauses of Han characters; each clause wrapped in sentence boundary markers.
One line in forty (SHA-256 of its text) held out; held-out Tatoeba and Common Voice lines form tests/data/heldout_*.tsv.
Clauses containing any evaluation sentence of four or more characters are excluded.
Interpolated modified Kneser-Ney estimation; count cutoffs 1/1/2/4 for orders 1-4 (1.3.0; 1/2/3/4 before); pruned rows renormalized.

Dialogue lines are held out by the same one-in-forty hash; held-out dialogue clauses that occur in no training text form tests/data/heldout_dialogue_*.tsv (dialogue repeats set phrases, so a clause also seen in training would only test recall). Clauses containing an evaluation sentence are excluded from training as before.

FineWeb-2 web pages from generated spam host names or with gambling/adult keywords are dropped, as are pages whose Han text has more than 1% Traditional-only characters; lines with fewer than six Han characters or less than half Han text are dropped and lines are deduplicated. The same one-in-forty hash holds lines out; evaluation sentences are excluded from training as for every source.
build_command: python tools/build_context_lm.py --input resources/dictionary/authoring/daily_*.txt:8 <other authoring .txt>:1 <work>/train/wikinews.txt:2 <work>/train/tatoeba.txt:3 <work>/train/cv.txt:3 <work>/train/kdconv.txt:2 <work>/train/crosswoz.txt:2 <work>/train/fineweb.txt:1 --fragments resources/dictionary/local_core_zh_pinyin.tsv:2 resources/dictionary/standard_zh_pinyin.tsv:2 resources/dictionary/core_zh_pinyin.tsv:2 --exclude tests/data/typing_holdout.tsv tests/data/typing_fresh.tsv tests/data/typing_independent.tsv tests/data/scenario_replay_076.tsv tests/data/common_word_order_079.tsv tests/data/heldout_sentences.tsv tests/data/heldout_dialogue_sentences.tsv --min-count 1 1 2 4 --output resources/dictionary/context_zh.lm

word_model.content: Association scores of adjacent lexicon word pairs and runs of three only; no sentence text is packaged.
processing: Clauses are segmented with the bundled lexicon by unigram dynamic programming, re-estimated once from the first segmentation.
Pairs seen at least 3 times (weighted) keep ln((count - 0.5) * N / (count(a) * count(b))) when it is at least 0.5 nats, clipped at 15.
Runs of three words seen at least 3 times keep ln((count(abc) - 0.5) * count(b) / (count(ab) * count(bc))) on the same terms (1.5.0).
Clauses containing any evaluation sentence are excluded, as for the character model.
word_model.build_command: python tools/build_word_model.py --input resources/dictionary/authoring/daily_*.txt:8 <other authoring .txt>:1 <work>/train/wikinews.txt:3 <work>/train/tatoeba.txt:3 <work>/train/cv.txt:3 <work>/train/kdconv.txt:3 <work>/train/crosswoz.txt:3 <work>/train/fineweb.txt:1 <work>/train/fineweb_extra.txt:1 <work>/train/fineweb_extra2.txt:1 --lexicon resources/dictionary/core_zh_pinyin.tsv resources/dictionary/local_core_zh_pinyin.tsv resources/dictionary/standard_zh_pinyin.tsv --exclude tests/data/typing_holdout.tsv tests/data/typing_fresh.tsv tests/data/typing_independent.tsv tests/data/scenario_replay_076.tsv tests/data/common_word_order_079.tsv tests/data/heldout_sentences.tsv tests/data/heldout_dialogue_sentences.tsv --output resources/dictionary/word_zh.lm

neural_model.content: Weights of a character GRU language model (8,000 characters, 256-wide embedding, 768-wide GRU, 4.6M parameters, half floats); no text is packaged.
processing: Same training text and weights as the word model (authoring prose, Wikinews, Tatoeba, Common Voice, KdConv, CrossWOZ, the three FineWeb-2 files).
Clauses containing any evaluation sentence of four or more characters are skipped, including the word-level and everyday-chat evaluation files.
Two passes over 250.6M characters, sequences of 128, AdamW with a one-cycle schedule; held-out stream perplexity 32.5.
neural_model.build_command: python tools/train_neural_lm.py --work <work> --output model.pt && python tools/export_neural_lm.py model.pt resources/dictionary/neural_zh.lm
